objective: Build a whole-body PBPK model for Digoxin that reproduces the observed plasma concentration-time data. Decide the model structure and any parameters you cannot obtain from the given data, and justify them. No modeling strategy and no reference results are provided.

literature_facts: Renal clearance via glomerular filtration is present.
Reference distribution/permeability methods exist but are withheld; choose your own.
